svg.title: Vale's layers
svg.desc: A screen of Vale at the Sanctum's door, as the player sees it, comes apart into the four sheets the console stacks to draw it, then closes again. From the back: the ground layer on BG3 with the grass, paths, water and steps; the middle layer on BG2 with the Sanctum's walls and door, the cliff edges and the feet of the posts; the sprites, here Isaac; and the overhead layer on BG1 with the Sanctum's roof, the tree top and the tops of the posts. Isaac stands in front of the middle layer and behind the overhead one because the layout gives the ground, middle and overhead layers priorities that put them behind, level with and in front of the sprites. BG0, kept for windows, is empty here.
svg.text: VALE, AS THE PLAYER SEES IT
